verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents workflows for automating processes (hubspot-docs-12, hubspot-docs-45). The webhooks API lets integrators subscribe to real-time CRM events (hubspot-docs-4), and the prospecting agent acts automatically on buying signals (hubspot-docs-14). Together these cover the core of event-triggered automation, but the workflow evidence is only a one-line mention. Missing for 10: documented detail on trigger types, rule/condition logic and available actions in workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
